[GitLab BV (Netherlands) Benefits > We've Got You Covered > Growing Families Leaves > Statutory Partner/Paternity Leave]
Time to bond with your new child and support your partner.

Leave Entitlement

* 5 days paid Birth Leave (100% salary), to be used within 4 weeks of birth
* 5 weeks paid Additional Birth Leave within 6 months (at 70% of maximum day wage)
* Review [company policy](/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave) as when more beneficial they supersede the statutory leave benefits

How to Access

1. Email [leaves@gitlab.com](mailto:leaves@gitlab.com) with your desired dates
1. Request the additional 5 weeks at least 4 weeks in advance

[GitLab BV (Belgium) Benefits > We've Got You Covered > Time Off & Leave Benefits > Parental Leave]
Maternity Leave Details

**Maternity Leave**

- 15 weeks total (6 prenatal, 9 postnatal)
- For team members with 6+ months tenure: 100% salary for up to 16 weeks
- Runs concurrently with [GitLab Parental Leave](/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave)
- Request via Workday 3 months before start date

Paternity/Co-Parent Leave Details

**Paternity/Co-Parent Leave**

- 20 days leave (15 days for births before January 1, 2023)
- Use within 4 months of birth
- 100% salary for up to 16 weeks (minus statutory entitlements)
- Runs concurrently with [GitLab's 16-week Parental Leave policy](/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave)
- GitLab tops up mutual insurance fund payments to 100% salary

[GitLab BV (Netherlands) Benefits > We've Got You Covered > Growing Families Leaves > Long-Term Care Leave]
Extended leave for serious, life-threatening illness of child, partner, or parent.

Leave Entitlement

* Up to 6x your weekly hours per year (e.g., 240 hours for full-time)
* Unpaid, but runs concurrently with PTO (100% pay for first 25 days)

How to Access

* Notify manager and [leaves@gitlab.com](mailto:leaves@gitlab.com) as soon as possible
